APE.label: bearish
APE.about: ApeCoin is the governance and utility token of the ApeCoin DAO and the Bored Ape Yacht Club / Yuga Labs ecosystem. It also pays gas on ApeChain, an Arbitrum-based chain for NFT, gaming and culture apps.
APE.summary: APE vesting is finished (last unlock Mar 17, 2026), so no new supply is coming. ApeCo's restructuring overview is no clear catalyst, leaving the bearish chart to technicals and sentiment.

news.title: ApeCo outlines its portfolio around ApeChain, BAYC and Otherside as stewardship of some Yuga collections changes hands

ZEC.label: bullish
ZEC.about: Zcash is a privacy-focused proof-of-work cryptocurrency that supports shielded (encrypted) transactions using zero-knowledge proofs. ZEC is used for payments and paying fees, and is mined with a fixed 21M supply cap.
ZEC.summary: ETF redemptions keep building and the treasury poll that starts Nov 16 adds governance uncertainty. ZEC is down about 31% on the week near $880, so the news flow works against a long for now.

news.title: Spot ZEC ETF (ZCSH) loses about $30.8M from Nov 9 to Nov 13, bringing November redemptions to roughly $43.8M
Nonbinding holder poll runs Nov 16-30 on a plan to move 50,000 ZEC out of the grants treasury and end grants' 8% share of block rewards
ZEC falls below $1,000 for the first time since September as longs are liquidated

XPL.label: bearish
XPL.about: Plasma is an EVM-compatible Layer-1 built for stablecoin payments, offering zero-fee USDT transfers and anchoring to Bitcoin. XPL is the native token used for gas, validator staking and network rewards.
XPL.summary: XPL sits near all-time lows (about $0.048-0.050) after an operational hiccup at Plasma One. A Nov 25 unlock of roughly 5% of market cap adds supply, which fits the bearish chart.

news.title: Plasma One users briefly locked out by a third-party login provider failure; Plasma says funds were unaffected
Plasma named a platinum sponsor of Binance Blockchain Week Bangkok (Nov 28-29), raising visibility but adding no clear demand
Binance restores HYPE and APT withdrawals after its October breach; PLASMA withdrawals remain pending security checks

unlocks.note: Monthly vesting to community/ecosystem, private investors and team (2.3% of total supply, about 4.9% of market cap per tokenomics.com). Tokenomist and CMC also list Nov 25 (CMC: ~227.8M).

ME.label: bearish
ME.about: Magic Eden is an NFT and token trading platform that in 2026 closed its Bitcoin and EVM marketplaces to focus on Solana and 'crypto entertainment'. ME is its governance and rewards token, with 15% of platform revenue going to buybacks and staker rewards.
ME.summary: No material ME news in the past week, and the next unlock is Dec 10 (22.4M ME, about 4.8% of market cap), outside the 14-day window. The chart has no fresh catalyst behind it.

HYPER.label: bearish
HYPER.about: Hyperlane is a permissionless interoperability protocol that lets apps send messages and bridge tokens (Warp Routes) across 150+ chains, including EVM, Solana and Cosmos networks. HYPER is used for staking to secure the network, governance, and rewards for users and chains that expand its use.
HYPER.summary: About 22.26M HYPER (roughly 5.7% of market cap) unlocks Nov 22, mostly to insiders and investors, adding supply in line with the bearish chart. No offsetting news this week.

unlocks.note: Monthly vesting: insiders ~47%, community ~22%, private investors ~20%, foundation ~11%; about 2.2% of total supply and 5.7% of market cap per Tokenomics.com.

SYRUP.label: bearish
SYRUP.about: Maple Finance is an onchain lending platform making overcollateralized loans to institutions and offering yield products such as syrupUSDC. SYRUP is its governance token, and part of protocol revenue buys it back.
SYRUP.summary: Leadership exits and shrinking syrupUSDC assets keep sentiment negative (SYRUP about $0.107, down about 23% in 7 days). The reserves check is partial reassurance that could spark short-covering bounces; no unlocks remain.

news.title: Maple runs an out-of-cycle proof of reserves showing about $1.89B collateral and syrup pools 138-156% overcollateralized, amid withdrawal worries
Maple co-founder Joe Flanagan and COO Ryan O'Shea leave after a strategy split with the CEO
SYRUP falls almost 50% in four weeks while lending assets shrink and buybacks stay small

VVV.label: bullish
VVV.about: Venice is a privacy-first AI platform offering private, uncensored access to text, image and code models via app and API. Staking VVV gives a share of free API inference capacity, and part of supply is burned.
VVV.summary: New exchange access (CoinJar, Poloniex, HTX) and a Hayes-linked wallet receiving VVV give the long a supportive backdrop, and no cliff unlocks are scheduled. Ongoing emissions still exceed the monthly burns, so supply keeps growing slowly.

news.title: Poloniex opens VVV deposits and HTX opens deposits with trading to follow, widening exchange access
CoinJar lists VVV for buying, selling, storing and sending
Wallet linked to Arthur Hayes receives about 15K VVV (~$306K) from a Flowdesk wallet; terms not disclosed, so a purchase is unconfirmed

XMR.label: bullish
XMR.about: Monero is a privacy-focused proof-of-work cryptocurrency where sender, receiver and amount are hidden by default. XMR is used for private payments and has a small perpetual tail emission.
XMR.summary: The XMR1 crash hit a wrapped token from Wagyu, not Monero itself, but it adds to negative sentiment after a roughly 20% weekly drop and recent delistings. The clean FCMP++ audit is a longer-term positive with no activation date, so it is unlikely to drive price right away.

news.title: Wagyu's wrapped XMR1 token collapses over 99% after an issuer-linked wallet sells about $13.5M on Hyperliquid; native Monero not affected
zkSecurity audit of the FCMP++ privacy upgrade finds no high or medium severity issues; no hard-fork date yet

FOGO.label: bearish
FOGO.about: Fogo is a Solana-VM-compatible Layer-1 built for low-latency on-chain trading. FOGO pays gas, is staked to secure the network and funds ecosystem incentives.
FOGO.summary: An investor and insider unlock on Nov 26 (about 2.4% of market cap per DropsTab) adds sell-side supply that fits the short. No major news this week; Bitget's early-November delisting still limits liquidity.

unlocks.note: Core contributors, Echo raise investors, institutional investors and advisors. Tokenomist dates the next unlock Nov 26 (no amount given). DropsTab shows 128.63M FOGO due in 4 days (1.29% of total supply, ~2.39% of market cap). Tokenomics.com lists 171.5M FOGO on its monthly schedule but dates its events the 15th (Nov 15, Dec 15), so amount and date differ there.

SOPH.label: bearish
SOPH.about: Sophon was a consumer-focused Ethereum L2 built on ZKsync tech that is shutting its chain to focus on apps on Base. SOPH was its gas, staking and governance token and is migrating to an Ethereum ERC-20.
SOPH.summary: Sophon is shutting down its mainnet on Nov 30 (withdrawals by Nov 25), Upbit ended SOPH trading on Nov 16, and about 170M SOPH unlocks on Nov 28. All of this points in the short's favor, but thin liquidity can cause sharp squeezes.

news.title: Upbit ends SOPH trading on its KRW, BTC and USDT markets on Nov 16; withdrawals stay open until Dec 16

unlocks.note: Single source: DropsTab shows it due in 2 days (0.13% of total supply, ~0.25% of market cap). Not listed by Tokenomics.com; Tokenomist shows no upcoming events.

Private investors, insiders and community. Tokenomics.com: 169.45M SOPH on Nov 28 (1.7% of total supply, 3.1% of market cap). DropsTab shows about 169.9M across three tranches due in 6 days, which matches Nov 28. Tokenomist shows no upcoming events.

2Z.label: bearish
2Z.about: DoubleZero is a high-performance fiber network for Solana and other chains' validators, aimed at cutting latency and bandwidth costs. 2Z pays for network access and rewards bandwidth contributors.
2Z.summary: No new catalyst this week, and the Kalshi/Edge data deal was already known. About 135.4M 2Z (1.4% of total supply) unlocks on Dec 2, mostly to insiders, which adds supply while the token sits near its lows.

unlocks.note: Insiders ~78.5%, private investors ~18.5%, community ~3.1%. Tokenomics.com puts it at 1.4% of total supply and ~2.6% of market cap. A CoinMarketCap tracker estimate and DropsTab also list a Dec 2 event; neither gives a percent of circulating supply. Separate ~31M 2Z/week linear releases are also estimated.

TRUMP.label: bearish
TRUMP.about: Official Trump (TRUMP) is a Solana memecoin tied to Donald Trump and run by Fight Fight Fight LLC. It has no protocol use beyond speculation and holder perks such as gala dinner access for top wallets.
TRUMP.summary: TRUMP is at record lows below $1, and demand for the Nov 22 holder gala collapsed 94% compared with the first one, so the gala passing today removes a reason to hold. No unlock cliff is scheduled in the window, but insider wallets keep releasing about 6.3M TRUMP a week (~0.5% of float) under linear vesting.

news.title: Reuters: interest in the third Trump memecoin dinner fades, with the 130 qualifying wallets holding only $8.6M, as TRUMP hits record lows
A gala seat that once needed ~$55K of TRUMP was reportedly won with a $518 buy; the token is down about 98% from its peak, and Democrats plan oversight

JTO.label: bearish
JTO.about: Jito is Solana's largest liquid-staking and MEV infrastructure project (JitoSOL, the Jito block engine and the Block Assembly Marketplace). JTO is its governance token, with JTX platform revenue going to buybacks and burns under JIP-38.
JTO.summary: JTO's vesting schedule ended with the Nov 7 unlock, so no new supply is due. This week's only news is the Jito CEO's call for more focus on security, which does not change the token, so the short rests on the chart alone.

news.title: Jito Labs CEO Lucas Bruder urges crypto builders to slow down and fix security gaps; Jito is adding security staff

HEMI.label: bearish
HEMI.about: Hemi is a modular Layer-2 that joins Bitcoin and Ethereum, anchoring state to Bitcoin so developers can build BTC DeFi with EVM tools. HEMI pays network fees and is staked as veHEMI for governance and yield.
HEMI.summary: There is no fresh Hemi news. The Nov 29 unlock of ~341M HEMI (3.4% of total supply, ~11% of market cap) goes mostly to investors and insiders, a large supply overhang a week out.

unlocks.note: Re-verified on tokenomics.com: private investors 34.2%, insiders 30.5%, community 20.4%, foundation 14.8%; 3.4% of total supply and ~11% of market cap. Circulating supply is ~4.25B. DropsTab and CryptoRank could not be loaded to cross-check.

ACE.label: bearish
ACE.about: Fusionist (ACE) is a Web3 gaming project with sci-fi strategy titles and its own Endurance chain. ACE is the gas token and in-game currency for that ecosystem.
ACE.summary: No ACE-specific news was found for Nov 15-22, and the next monthly unlock (about 2.97M ACE on Dec 18) falls outside the window. The Nov 18 unlock already passed, and price fell about 12% in the three days after it.

BOME.label: bearish
BOME.about: BOOK OF MEME is a Solana memecoin themed around permanently storing meme culture on decentralized storage. BOME has no real utility and trades on speculation and community attention.
BOME.summary: No catalysts this week: no BOME news since Nov 15 and no vesting, since supply is fully circulating. Price action is driven by memecoin sentiment, and BOME was down about 15% over the past week as of Nov 20.

BERA.label: bearish
BERA.about: Berachain is an EVM-compatible Layer-1 using Proof-of-Liquidity, where validators direct rewards to liquidity providers. BERA is the gas and staking token, while BGT handles governance and reward emissions.
BERA.summary: The largest BERA treasury company, Greenlane, reported that its holdings' value fell from about $21.8M to $8.5M by Nov 16 while BERA keeps setting record lows, which hurts the treasury-bid story. No discrete unlocks are scheduled through Dec 6, though linear vesting continues.

news.title: BERA treasury firm Greenlane reports ~85.8M BERA held; holdings value down to ~$8.5M by Nov 16

BLUR.label: bearish
BLUR.about: Blur is a pro-trader NFT marketplace and aggregator on Ethereum that also ran Blend, a peer-to-peer NFT lending product. BLUR is its governance token and controls the fee switch.
BLUR.summary: Blur retired its website in mid-November, and Upbit and Bithumb are set to stop BLUR trading on Nov 30 (announced Oct 30), which removes major Korean liquidity. No discrete unlocks are due, but about 5M BLUR per week still vests continuously.

MELANIA.label: bearish
MELANIA.about: MELANIA is a Solana memecoin launched in January 2025 and linked to Melania Trump. It has no product utility and trades purely on sentiment and attention.
MELANIA.summary: No MELANIA-specific catalyst since Nov 15. Coverage of Trump-family tokens remains negative (MELANIA is about 99% off its peak, and the TRUMP coin is at 2026 lows). Tokenomics.com shows the vesting schedule ended Jan 2026, so no unlocks are due through Dec 6.

POPCAT.label: bearish
POPCAT.about: Popcat is a Solana memecoin built around the viral 'popping cat' internet meme. It has no utility beyond trading and community or speculative use.
POPCAT.summary: The only fresh headline is a former Robinhood engineer pleading guilty to front-running listings, POPCAT among them, on Hyperliquid. It names no wrongdoing by the token itself, and there are no unlocks because supply is fully circulating. The roughly 25% weekly slide reflects the broad memecoin selloff, not a POPCAT-specific catalyst.

news.title: Ex-Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to front-running token listings, including POPCAT, via Hyperliquid perps

FARTCOIN.label: bearish
FARTCOIN.about: Fartcoin is a Solana memecoin that grew out of an AI-generated joke from the Truth Terminal bot. It has no product utility and is traded purely for speculation and community attention.
FARTCOIN.summary: A small exchange delisting adds a mild negative on top of a roughly 29% weekly drop during extreme market fear. Supply is fully circulating, so no unlocks are due, and nothing positive surfaced that would argue against the bearish chart.

news.title: MGBX delists FARTCOIN/USDT spot pair on Nov 19, citing low liquidity and volume

PENGU.label: bearish
PENGU.about: PENGU is the Solana-based community and brand token of the Pudgy Penguins NFT franchise. It is used for community rewards, games and the brand's wider consumer ecosystem (toys, media).
PENGU.summary: PENGU lost about 27% in a week amid a broad altcoin selloff, and Igloo is shutting its Abstract L2 on Dec 15, which adds ecosystem uncertainty even though PENGU itself is not on Abstract. The next unlock (703.92M PENGU, team/company) is on Dec 17, outside this window, so supply is not an immediate factor.

news.title: Pudgy Penguins opens migration tool ahead of Abstract L2 shutdown on Dec 15; PENGU not directly affected

KAITO.label: bearish
KAITO.about: Kaito is an AI-driven crypto research and InfoFi platform that ranks social attention and links brands with creators. KAITO is used for staking, governance and access to platform rewards.
KAITO.summary: The Nov 20 monthly unlock has just passed, and no unlock falls between Nov 22 and Dec 6. Tokenomist dates the next one to Dec 20 (17.6M KAITO; Tokenomist says 3.43% of released supply, while a CoinMarketCal report says 7.29% of circulating). Supply overhang and a roughly 30% monthly decline keep the backdrop bearish.

news.title: Report flags up to 17.6M KAITO unlocking in December across team, investors, foundation and ecosystem
